data.long_meaning: Omi is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Aum’ which represents the universal consciousness and the beginning of creation. The name Omi signifies intelligence, radiance, and wisdom. The name Omi carries the meaning “Intelligent, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Parents who choose Omi usually hope their child will grow to embody intelligent, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.spiritual_significance: The name Omi holds immense spiritual significance because it is derived from the sacred syllable ‘Aum’.
